approach: Write the distance fallen by each stone measured from the same start of timing, and set them equal at the overtaking instant.

steps.text: Let t be the time measured from when the first stone is dropped. Write the distance fallen by the first stone.
The second stone starts 1 s later with initial speed 20 m/s downward. Write its distance fallen for t ≥ 1 s.
Set the two distances equal, since the second stone overtakes the first at the same position.
Substitute t = 1.5 s into the first stone's distance to get the overtaking distance.
